acceptance: READY authors and reviewer model ids are compared after one normalization in review_eligible (case-folded, a roster harness or profile alias mapped to the roster api_id), so a READY naming a case variant or an alias of the executor's model still excludes the executor's own review; an id matching two roster entries keeps the gate closed with a problem naming both. Authenticating authorship stays out of scope (honour-system, docs/orchestration-review.md)

read_acceptance does its presence check (lstat) inside the unreadable boundary: an unreadable parent (PermissionError) or a dangling POLICY-ACCEPTED.yaml link is an invalid-acceptance gate problem, not a traceback or absence; the caller check opens work/.workers/<id>.yaml with O_NONBLOCK and requires a regular file by fstat, refusing a FIFO or other non-regular record with CallerError at once

write_rejected and write_human_approval share write_review's case-variant unlink, so the stored names are REJECTED-<model>.md and REVIEW-human.md; unreadable_rejected_lines matches REJECTED-*.md case-insensitively

Tests: READY with a case variant and with a roster alias -> executor's review excluded; ambiguous alias -> gate closed; PermissionError on the acceptance parent (stubbed) and a dangling acceptance link -> gate and finish refuse cleanly; a FIFO worker record (POSIX, CLI under a 5 s timeout) -> refused at once, nothing written; an existing rejected-<model>.md / review-human.md (case-insensitive volume simulated as tests/test_review_file_case.py does) -> canonical names, listing finds them. docs/orchestration-review.md and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed

acceptance: terminate signals the snapshotted escaped descendants on the same SIGTERM/SIGKILL schedule as the group (not after the group grace); zombie (Z-state) entries do not count as survivors; a failed ps inventory is recorded on the worker record and the next terminate repeats the descendant pass instead of marking the worker terminated

finish's pre-commit restore writes a temp file and os.replace without unlinking first (on failure the previous bytes stay and the temp path is printed); snapshots keep regular-file mode bits and the restore applies them; the index restore refuses to discard staging that changed since the snapshot, keeping both versions and naming them

Tests: escaped child forked during the group grace -> signalled with the group, no survivor; a subreaper keeping an escaped zombie -> terminate succeeds; ps failing on the first terminate -> the second signals the escaped descendants; restore write raising OSError (stubbed) -> previous bytes still there; executable and 0600 cleanup files after a failing pre-commit hook -> modes restored; an unrelated path staged during the hook -> kept or saved and named. docs/orchestration-workers.md terminate paragraph and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed

acceptance: brainstorm verify drops a bracket only when it is a citation marker on the page and absent from the quote; a quote that keeps a bracket must match it exactly (page [43] vs quote [44], [a] vs [b] -> not-found), while a page [43] against a quote without it still matches and the typographic folds stay

upgrade --dry-run renders the digest with the live checkout's history as a read-only input (no writable link into live .git), so on the finished-leaf fixture with a current digest containing Quality by area the dry run predicts no digest write and the real upgrade writes none

apply's rollback snapshot (roadmap_crud_dependency_ops _restore) keeps entry type and link text: archiving an in-repo linked sheet, then a refused edit of missing M404 in the same batch, restores the symlink (is_symlink, readlink, target bytes and location)

safe_write traverses by directory descriptor (os.open with O_NOFOLLOW per component, os.replace with dir fds; M21.37's re-check kept where dir_fd is unsupported) and archive moves use the path as spelled under that traversal, not an earlier resolve(); deterministic tests swap a destination or a parent for a link between the walk and the replace for generated files, the managed block and archive moves -> refused, outside unchanged. docs/brainstorming.md verify paragraph and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed
